_meta.what: Phase-P RenderStats baseline (RENDERER_OPTIMIZATION_PLAN.md §Phase P). The numbers every later phase's ✅ DONE WHEN is measured AGAINST. Re-record with `npm run harness:webgpu:verify -- simstorm` (the BASELINE_JSON console line) after a deliberate change; an UNEXPECTED move is the signal.
_meta.phase: Phases 0-5 + P2 INDEX-ARENA follow-up. liveBuffers 28→17: the per-section translucent INDEX buffers are now sub-allocations in ONE shared index BufferArena (the §11 vertex-arena pattern extended to indices) — ~12 per-section index buffers collapsed to 1. A re-sort updates the index allocation IN PLACE (U6); the BufferArena now has O(1) rangeOf (byId map — kills the O(sections²) collectDraws), best-fit allocation, and shrink-on-compact reclaim (U8, commit-gated). Geometry pixel-identical (DYNAMIC glass re-sorts correctly through the arena byte-offset; stress holes 0.00%). Off-thread meshing live (frameMs ~0.28, all four per-frame alloc metrics 0).
_meta.units: ms for *Ms; counts otherwise. drawCalls/passes/alloc*/jobs* are PER-FRAME deltas; liveBuffers is an absolute gauge; resorts is cumulative. Each metric is {avg, p95, max} across the run's sampled frames.
_meta.notes: sectionsCulled = 0 because the 41-section world is fully in-frustum at the harness camera (culling is exercised separately by harness/stress at 768 sections). RESULTS: allocRawVertex 80447→0 (#1 single-pass inline encode), allocDrawList 41→0 (OCC-2-l1 scratch reuse), allocFrustum 2→0 (F4 reused flat-scalar frustum), allocEntityEmit 8→0 (F8/ENT-4 EntityScene pool + ENT-5 BE-origin cache); frameMs avg 0.41→0.28→0.3, encodeMs 0.07→0.03 (F7 per-draw guards). jobsMeshed≈jobsDirtied (N1 coalescing via the new Scheduler/TaskQueue) and jobsDiscarded=0 (no stale builds). Phase 2: liveBuffers 57→27 — the O(sections×passes) per-section vertex buffers are now sub-allocations in 3 shared per-pass vertex BufferArenas (committed sections carry a stable AllocationId; collectDraws resolves arena buffer+byte-offset at draw time, so arena grow/compaction is invisible to `presented`). Translucent INDEX buffers stay per-section (the remaining count) — arena-ing them is the deferred follow-up. REMAINING targets: drawCalls (Phase 4 batched draw); sectionsCulled (Phase 3 occlusion). Meshing runs via scheduler.tick BEFORE the frame timer, so frameMs stays render-encode-only and comparable.
